scope: Static base-game front-end evidence for a menu-first rebuild, not a running menu or recovered UI implementation.
integration_target: Our own rebuilt 32-bit Windows executable using the original LS3DF.dll and locally installed assets through Proton. No replacement menu mockup or original-client patch.

startup_path.role: Controller state transitions; video sequence 4 enters the null-descriptor front end
Null descriptor allocates 0x240 bytes, installs 00815e30 and calls initializer slot +04

menu_dependencies.role: Shared front-end initializer: scene, camera, light, sound, derived setup +40, content setup and cursor
Menu-specific setup selected by slot +40; also calls unresolved opaque pointer 00a59000
Loads cursor/confirmation resources, then invokes derived slot +38
Slot +38 builds definitions, loads models and binds typed UI controls
Constructs main-menu, profile, single-player and other screen/control definitions
Creates kind-9 model and calls client resource loader 004290a0
Menu event dispatch, including tagged control events
Shared update path; invokes derived slot +48 and updates bound objects
Shared scene-render path, ending in cursor draw 0066a870
Cursor setup, CURZOR lookup and x_kursor.tga texture request
Scene callback supplied by initializer; full callback contract not recovered

state_ids.note: Type comes from slot +1c; transition status comes from +20. These and the initializer's internal +20 field are not one interchangeable enum.

instruction_anchors.meaning: Post-intro branch calls 006c0ef0 with two zero arguments
Create FRAME_SCENE through driver +54; store at object +30
Scene +74 gets self, callback 0066e0f0 and flags 4
Invoke derived setup +40 with saved descriptor
UI resource helper creates FRAME_MODEL through driver +54

resource_anchors.role: Screen definition label, not a filename

limitations: A graphics-only host now compiles, but no engine window or interactive menu is runtime-verified; see engine-host-map.json.
Resource keys and control names are not verified archive paths or localized displayed captions.
Indirect-call signatures remain incomplete; current generated C has incorrect stack/argument propagation and is not recovered source.
Original engine initialization, resource search/archive registration, text/font services, input ABI and teardown still need integration contracts.
Opaque calls through 00a59000 are unresolved and must not be assumed dispensable.
Transient Ghidra definitions do not revise the frozen function baseline or earn reconstruction credit.
Sabre Squadron is excluded; no original game files or user baseline database were modified.
